(Japanese: '''～序章～メガガブリアスの物語''' ''~Prologue~ The Story of Mega {{tt|Gaburias|Garchomp}}'') is the first bonus chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters XY: The Legend of the Pokémon Dragon King]] manga. It first appeared as a sneak preview in the November 2013 issue of [[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics]] magazine and later appeared in the collected volume release as a bonus chapter.
